title: Credo (Du Fay, Missa Ecce ancilla domini)
desc: Guillaume Du Fay, Missa Ecce ancilla domini, Credo. 4 voices (Cantus, Contratenor, Tenor 1, Tenor 2), each on its own staff. Source: Ed. J. Rodin based on edition by A. Planchart. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Duf1003c); encoded by Jesse Rodin Alejandro Planchart. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0; converted to Cantare notation (tools/kern2cantare.py). Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
